children: "Netflix and chill" might be drying up in the U.S., but that doesn't mean investors should give up on Netflix stock.

As the video streamer has struggled to release creative hits that drive viewer engagement this year, shares have suffered. Netflix stock has fallen 26% this year and has declined 36% since closing at a recent high of $107.79 on April 16.
Deutsche Bank believes the share price decline now offers investors an attractive entry point. The firm upgraded Netflix stock to Buy from Hold but lowered its price target to $95 from $100.
Netflix stock rose 1.2% to $70.05 in premarket trading on Tuesday after ending Monday down 2.7%.
Deutsche Bank broadly believes the stock market's "obsession" with U.S. engagement on Netflix overlooks the company's larger total addressable market and "healthier" international trends.
The firm noted that international engagement time on Netflix has steadily increased and that this year's softness in U.S. "could simply be driven by less creative success."
None of that takes away from the success and market position that Netflix has built over years in the streaming sector, according to the firm.
While Deutsche Bank sounded a bullish none on Netflix, the view was far from universal.
Wells Fargo analyst Steven Cahall recently downgraded Netflix to Underweight from Equal Weight and slashed his price target to $57 from $80. HSBC last week also downgraded Netflix to Hold from Buy.
Much of this sentiment is due to the belief that Netflix engagement is on a downward trajectory. HSBC noted that Alphabet-owned YouTube is taking increasing viewer share from Netflix.

Netflix stunned investors in July when it said it would would start publishing its flagship engagement report once instead of twice a year, fueling fears that it has been bleeding subscribers to rival streamers.
Deutsche Bank believes the concern is overblown, and while some firms disagree the majority still view Netflix stock favorably.
Of the 45 Wall Street firms polled by FactSet, Netflix stock has an average Overweight rating with a price target of $93.57. The stock has 28 Buy ratings and 17 Hold ratings, according to FactSet.
